label: Иметь
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for иметь (to have).

missions.phrase: Я имею полное право знать правду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Имею' is the я-form of the imperfective иметь, with the stem in -е and the ending -ю. The fixed phrase 'иметь право' means to have the right to something.

missions.phrase: Ты имеешь очень большой опыт работы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Имеешь' shows the first-conjugation -ешь ending built on the stem име-. 'Опыт работы' is the accusative object of this slightly formal verb.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Имеет' is the он-form ending in -ет. The collocation 'иметь значение' means to matter or to have importance, one of the most common uses of this verb.

missions.phrase: Мы имеем общие цели и планы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Имеем' is the мы-form ending in -ем. Иметь is imperfective and rather bookish; in casual speech 'у нас есть' is often preferred.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Имеют' closes the present ladder with the -ют ending. 'Двойной смысл' is the accusative object meaning a double meaning.

missions.phrase: В детстве я имел много друзей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Имел' is the masculine singular past of the imperfective иметь. 'В детстве' frames the ongoing past state of possessing many friends.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Имела' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Раньше' marks a habitual past situation; the imperfective stresses the lasting state of ownership.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Имели' is the plural past ending in -и. 'Старый дом' is the accusative object and 'наши соседи' supplies a natural plural subject.

missions.phrase: Скоро ты будешь иметь свой дом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future. 'Будешь иметь' joins 'будешь' with the infinitive иметь, since this imperfective verb forms its future analytically. 'Скоро' projects the ongoing future state.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. The impersonal 'важно' governs the bare infinitive иметь. 'Иметь терпение' means to have patience; иметь is most natural exactly in such fixed abstract phrases.
